# Measure whether gaze returns to where it was.

[Compare fixation patterns, scanpaths, and density maps across conditions — built for memory researchers studying gaze reinstatement between encoding and retrieval.]{.lead}

[Get started →](get-started.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[API reference](reference/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}

[density maps]{.kicker} [template similarity]{.kicker} [MultiMatch scanpaths]{.kicker}
:::
::: {.hero-code}
::: {.code-card}
[quickstart.py]{.code-card-title}
```python
import numpy as np
from peyesim import fixation_group, eye_density, similarity

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)

fg = fixation_group(
    x=rng.uniform(0, 100, 25),
    y=rng.uniform(0, 100, 25),
    onset=np.cumsum(rng.uniform(0, 100, 25)),
    duration=rng.uniform(50, 300, 25),
)
ed = eye_density(fg, sigma=50,
                 xbounds=(0, 100), ybounds=(0, 100))
similarity(ed, ed, method="pearson")  # 1.0
```
:::
:::
:::

## In 30 seconds {.promise-heading}

A raw fixation list says *where* the eyes went. To ask whether two viewings
land in the same places you need a spatial density and a similarity score —
two lines once the fixations exist.

```{python}
import numpy as np
from peyesim import fixation_group, eye_density, similarity

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)

def random_group():
    return fixation_group(
        x=rng.uniform(0, 100, 25),
        y=rng.uniform(0, 100, 25),
        onset=np.cumsum(rng.uniform(0, 100, 25)),
        duration=rng.uniform(50, 300, 25),
    )

encode, retrieve = random_group(), random_group()

ed_encode = eye_density(encode, sigma=50, xbounds=(0, 100), ybounds=(0, 100))
ed_retrieve = eye_density(retrieve, sigma=50, xbounds=(0, 100), ybounds=(0, 100))

score = similarity(ed_encode, ed_retrieve, method="pearson")
print(f"similarity = {score:.3f}")
```

The same pipeline scales to trial-level tables, permutation baselines, and
six-dimensional scanpath comparison without changing the verbs.

## Three promises {.promise-heading}

::: {.promise-grid}
::: {.promise-card}
#### Fixations to densities
Kernel density estimation with configurable bandwidth and multiscale support, tuned for typical eye-tracking spatial scales. [Get started](get-started.qmd)

[`eye_density()`]{.promise-tag}
:::

::: {.promise-card}
#### Template similarity
Compare encoding and retrieval gaze against permutation baselines, including cross-validated and latent-transform variants. [Tutorial](tutorials/overview.qmd)

[`template_similarity()`]{.promise-tag}
:::

::: {.promise-card}
#### Scanpath comparison
Six-dimensional MultiMatch plus cross-recurrence summaries over the fixation trajectory itself. [Tutorial](tutorials/multimatch.qmd)

[`multi_match()`]{.promise-tag}
:::
:::
